advancements.atomicadditions.root.title: Initial Atom
advancements.atomicadditions.root.desc: Get your first Atomic Additions item.
advancements.atomicadditions.engineering: Obtain both AMR blocks: the Casing and the Port.
advancements.atomicadditions.formed.desc: Build and form the Atomic Material Reprocessor (AMR) multiblock.
advancements.atomicadditions.operating.d: Power on the AMR and fuse two gases into one.
advancements.atomicadditions.gas_niobium: Produce Niobium gas in the Pressurized Reaction Chamber (iron ingots, water and chlorine).
advancements.atomicadditions.gas_germani: Produce Germanium gas (iron ingots, water and oxygen).
advancements.atomicadditions.tantalum.de: Fuse Niobium and Germanium in the AMR to produce Tantalum.
advancements.atomicadditions.activated_c: Use Tantalum to turn 5 crystals into 8 Activated Crystals.
advancements.atomicadditions.easy_path.d: Process Activated Crystals with HCl instead of Rhenium. It works, but yields half as much.
Produce Copper gas (copper ingots, water and uranium hexafluoride).
advancements.atomicadditions.gas_palladi: Produce Palladium gas from Copper gas (sulfur dust and water).
advancements.atomicadditions.rhenium.des: Fuse Palladium and Copper in the AMR to produce Rhenium.
advancements.atomicadditions.great_multi: Join Rhenium with Activated Crystals and get twice the shards of the HCl path.
book.atomicadditions.manual.name: Atomic Manual
book.atomicadditions.manual.landing: Everything you need to know about atomic fusion, from the first gas to the great multiplication.
